name: Cato Ferrin
bio: Learned gunnery on salvage, cutting hulls apart for parts. He still aims at the joins.

personality.label: Salvage mechanic
personality.description: Can identify a machine by its fasteners. Talks to damaged hardware more gently than to officers.

move: Hear that bearing? Still has a journey in it.
Moving. I tightened the important bits.
attack: There is the join. That is where it opens.
Let us take this apart properly.
guard: Bracing the joints. This position will do.
hold_fire: Tools down. Keep the good components intact.
investigate: Let me see how it is put together.
heavy_fire: They are undoing my repairs. Cover me.
That noise was expensive. I need some breathing room.
